site.name: simoncos
site.summary: A live public surface for software, AI collaboration, data projects, research artifacts, essays, talks, and field notes.

language_policy.agent_preference: Prefer English pages when both versions exist, unless the user asks for Chinese.
language_policy.section_pages: Section pages (Index, Articles, Work, Favorites, About) carry both languages; append ?lang=zh for Chinese.

entrypoints.label: Index
entrypoints.purpose: Selected work, recent articles and a short changelog.

entrypoints.label: Articles
entrypoints.purpose: Long-form writing archive, filterable by topic, with series.

entrypoints.label: Work
entrypoints.purpose: Tools, games, talks, research artifacts and music.

entrypoints.label: Tools
entrypoints.purpose: Index of maintained tools and systems; each project opens into its context, outputs, and related work.

entrypoints.label: Favorites (收藏)
entrypoints.purpose: Every book, film, album and game rated five stars on Douban, newest first, with the short reviews as written there. Page chrome is bilingual; titles and reviews are in Chinese.

entrypoints.label: About
entrypoints.purpose: Short profile, motto and contact links.

current_surfaces.label: Sleep Toolkit
current_surfaces.description: Project context, report preview, and routes to the web app and data essay.

current_surfaces.label: Sleep Toolkit web app
current_surfaces.description: Public tool for SleepCycle CSV analysis.

current_surfaces.label: Ten Years of Sleep Records, Analyzed
current_surfaces.description: A study of 3,656 nights of personal sleep records, with visual analysis and project context.

current_surfaces.label: Personal Information Systems in the AI Era
current_surfaces.description: Talk on capture, memory, agents, projects, and boundaries.

current_surfaces.label: Sunny Day (晴天)
current_surfaces.description: Original song, words, music and vocals by Che Zhao: the recording, with the Chinese lyrics and an English translation.

current_surfaces.label: 问题解决与设计
current_surfaces.description: Four completed essays, in Chinese and English, on problem situations, feasible solutions, open-ended problems, and indecision and the optimal solution.

current_surfaces.label: Zhihu 2015: People, Connections and Influence
current_surfaces.description: Bilingual interactive presentation of a 2015 study: profile statistics, follow-network comparisons, published influence rankings and topics. Historical sample, not current platform data.

current_surfaces.label: Reading Roundups (读书小结)
current_surfaces.description: Six reading roundups from 2015 to 2019, in Chinese and English, with the original book reviews and historical publication dates.

current_surfaces.label: Endless Echoes (漫无止尽的回响)
current_surfaces.description: A game in Work → Games: a bilingual branching music riddle through 36 songs, restored from a 2017 Douban list. Imagery clues and an author-selected quotation guide the trail; progress stays in the browser.

current_surfaces.label: HN Field Notes
current_surfaces.description: Read-only HN WAYWO project browser with source evidence and monthly candidate trends. Updated monthly by Hermes.
